avis.titre: Must Apply Properly for best results
avis.texte: This review addresses common concerns and misinformation surrounding the capsule cream formulation. The sensation of stickiness or tackiness, often mentioned in other reviews, is typically a direct consequence of over-application or insufficient time for proper epidermal absorption. Minimal product is required: we recommend combining one capsule with an amount of the accompanying clear gel that is equal to or slightly greater than the capsule volume, and ensuring the product is allowed adequate time to absorb completely. Furthermore, due to widespread misinformation on social media, it is critical to clarify that you must not co-apply (layer) the various capsule creams simultaneously; they can be used in an alternating schedule, but not together. Finally, it is imperative to always consult with your dermatologist before introducing any new product to your regimen. This preventative step mitigates the risk of adverse reactions with existing products and prevents the potential for ingredient overload, as applying multiple products with similar active ingredients can compromise the skin's natural barrier function.
